description: This source file defines the EmpEmergencyContactAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee emergency contacts within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting emergency contact records, with appropriate validation rules, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and integration with underlying service and data models.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for Employee Emergency Contacts, including listing, creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, with validation and Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list employee emergency contacts with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing emergency contact.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Utility method to create or update an employee emergency contact based on request data.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactService
methods.description: Getter for the service managing emergency contact data, with lazy initialization.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactService
methods.description: Setter to inject a custom or mocked service for testing.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing emergency contacts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating an emergency contact.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting emergency contacts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single emergency contact.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an emergency contact.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to generate common validation rules for POST/PUT request bodies.
